notes.title: Past Mistakes – Episode 2 v0.2: Release Date!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey hey everyone! It's that time again! 🙂🍾[/p][p]We’re super excited to finally share the release date for [b]Episode 2 v0.2[/b] of [b]Past Mistakes[/b]! 🏆

The new update is scheduled for release on the same day as the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b], [b]September 29th[/b]. Don't miss your chance to grab a copy if you haven't already!  As always thank you so much for your support! 💜[/p]
